name: Óbuda University
summary: Budapest technical and business university: eight of its 16 BSc degrees are taught entirely in English, each seven semesters.

ib.text: No IB points rule: upload your Diploma and a report card showing Maths, Physics and English. English B2 (IELTS 5.5) is waived if your schooling was fully in English. Online entrance tests follow.

programmes.name: Business Administration and Management
programmes.about: Trains economists to understand, plan and analyse how business organisations run, with specialisations in Digital Manager or Project Management and B2B Marketing; includes a work placement (210 ECTS).
programmes.overview: The degree is practice-oriented, mixing mathematics, statistics, economics and market research with finance, accounting, marketing, management, HR and project management, and later topics such as supply chain management, strategic planning, controlling, innovation, crisis management and digital marketing. A semester-long compulsory internship, a project module and a thesis defended in the final exam tie it to practice, and optional cooperative training modules with partner companies are available. You choose a specialisation in Project Management and B2B Marketing or in Digital Manager. It prepares you to organise and manage enterprise activities and to continue to a master's.
programmes.selectionNote: Online Maths test after your documents are checked, then an oral exam. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Commerce and Marketing
programmes.about: Economics and business knowledge with commerce and marketing skills for selling products and services and running commercial activity in small and medium firms (210 ECTS).
programmes.overview: The programme combines economics and business methodology with social sciences and core commerce and marketing subjects; final exams include trade economics, foreign trade techniques, marketing management and marketing communication. In the later semesters you choose between Digital Marketing Communication and Project Management and B2B Marketing. A compulsory professional internship of at least twelve weeks in the last semester and a thesis defended in the final exam complete the degree. Graduates are economic professionals for the supply and sale of products and services, including managing the commercial side of small and medium enterprises, and can go on to a master's.
programmes.selectionNote: Online Maths test after your documents are checked, then an oral exam. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Computer Science Engineering
programmes.about: Programming, software engineering, databases, networks and security, with a specialisation in Cloud Service Technologies and IT Security from semester four (210 ECTS).
programmes.overview: You study advanced programming and software technology, database design, big data and business intelligence, operating systems and networks, server services and security, mobile app development, embedded systems and robot programming, cloud computing and information security. From semester four the specialisation is Cloud Service Technologies and IT Security: IT infrastructure, virtualisation, distributed systems, containers, IoT, big data and DevOps. Electives reach into bioinformatics, robotics and intelligent systems, the thesis can be done with company support, and Erasmus exchange with partner universities is possible. Graduates enter the job market or continue to a master's.
programmes.selectionNote: Online test in Maths plus Physics or Informatics, then an oral exam. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Electrical Engineering
programmes.about: Electrical engineering with natural sciences, economics and humanities, and specialisations in automation, communication technologies, embedded systems or energy (210 ECTS).
programmes.overview: The degree rests on natural science fundamentals, economics and humanities and a large block of professional electrical engineering knowledge, taught through lectures, seminars and compulsory laboratory practice, with project work, reports and presentations. In the final semesters you follow Applied Electrical Engineering, a broad specialisation joining building automation, infocommunication networks, sensors and actuators, artificial intelligence, energy systems, solar power and data transmission, aimed at flexibility across automation, energy, renewables and industrial systems. A six-week traineeship and a thesis complete the programme, which leads on to master's study in electrical engineering.
programmes.selectionNote: Online Maths and Physics tests, then an oral exam. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Engineering Management
programmes.about: Engineering managers with natural and technical science, economics and organisation skills for production and service work, with specialisations in project or corporate management (210 ECTS).
programmes.overview: You study mathematics, physics, electrotechnics, chemistry and materials science alongside enterprise economics, HR management, accounting, law and marketing, with a professional core of technical drawing, manufacturing technology, quality, innovation and project management, decision support systems, lean management and logistics. Later you choose a track as Project Manager, in Process Management or in Corporate Management. A mandatory six-week internship with an outside organisation, project work and a defended thesis are included, and a voluntary cooperative training module lets you work on site with partner companies.
programmes.selectionNote: Online Maths test after your documents are checked, then an oral exam. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Environmental Engineering
programmes.about: Applied natural sciences, ecology, technology and management for preventing and cleaning up pollution and using resources well; specialisations in energy, green energy and land, or water (210 ECTS).
programmes.overview: The course draws on biology, chemistry, physics, ecology and earth sciences, and on environmental protection topics: water, air and soil quality, noise and radiation protection, and waste management. Technology subjects include wastewater treatment, renewable energy systems, environmental simulation and GIS, with environmental law, quality management and project management alongside. Learning involves laboratory work, field measurements, a project course, a required internship and a thesis. You can follow Sustainable Energy Management and Green Energy, or Sustainable Land Development and Water Management. Graduates work as environmental managers in enterprises and plants, or continue to the university's Environmental Engineering master's.
programmes.selectionNote: Online Maths test plus one of Physics, Chemistry, Biology or Informatics. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Industrial Design Engineering
programmes.about: Engineers who design, make and market industrial products, with product design (interior, textile, fashion accessories) or packaging specialisations; combines technology, aesthetics and economics (210 ECTS).
programmes.overview: Design and engineering are taught together: freehand drawing, form design, modelling, design visualisation, colour theory and art studies on one side, and mathematics, physics, technical mechanics, machine elements, CAD/CAM and technical documentation on the other, with enterprise economics, marketing, project management and environmental studies. Studio and lab work counts toward grades. You choose between Product Design, centred on interior, textile and fashion accessories with sustainable approaches, and Packaging Design, covering packaging materials, printing technologies and eco-friendly design. An internship and a thesis are part of the degree, which prepares for a master's.
programmes.ib: Drawing portfolio as one PDF: a geometric-bodies drawing, a drapery study and free drawings or designs.
programmes.selectionNote: Online Maths test plus one of Physics, Chemistry, Biology or Informatics, and a drawing portfolio. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Mechatronical Engineering
programmes.about: Mechanical engineering, electronics and computer control together, for designing and running mechatronic devices and smart machines; robotics or intelligent control specialisation (210 ECTS).
programmes.overview: Mechanical engineering is combined with electronics, electrotechnics and computer control, resting on mathematics, mechanics, electricity and informatics applied at systems level. The course suits people who like to experiment and see their ideas working in practice. You can specialise in Robotics or in Intelligent Control Systems. Graduates are prepared to design and build smart devices and robots with artificial intelligence, or to continue to a master's degree.
programmes.selectionNote: Online Maths and Physics tests, then an oral exam. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

notes: EU/EEA applicants pay EUR 2,000 a semester for every BSc, against EUR 2,700 to 3,200 for non-EEA applicants; there is also a EUR 150 application fee.
Every school-leaving document needs a notarised English translation, even when the original is in English.
Applicants must be 18 by the start of the study period; if you are still in your final school year, upload the school-leaving certificate by 1 August.
